apps.name: AiLagoon
apps.shortDescription: AI model hub — aggregate Ollama, ChatGPT, OpenRouter; pin inference transcripts.
apps.description:
# AiLagoon

The AI model hub pearl for Melusina. Register multiple LLM providers,
manage per-model connections, and expose AI capabilities to other
pearls via Grapple — all behind a single Sandstorm HTTP-out permission
to the ai-lagoon sidecar.

## Providers

- **Ollama** — local or remote Ollama server, any model it can host
- **ChatGPT** — OpenAI-compatible API (GPT-4o, 4.1, o1, o3, 4.5, 4.6)
- **OpenRouter** — 100+ models from Anthropic, Google, Meta, Mistral,
  DeepSeek, and more through a single proxy

## Grapple capabilities published by this pearl

Other pearls can request AI from AiLagoon via Grapple:

- `ai-text` — generic text / chat completion
- `ai-vision` — image understanding and OCR
- `ai-generic` — consumer picks a model in the Grapple UI at grant time
- Direct per-model — scoped to one provider + model, useful when a
  consumer wants a specific capability class (e.g. reasoning)

## How HTTP-out works

All providers route through `https://ailagoon.sidecar.host`; the
sidecar's path prefix (`/{provider}/{apiKey}/...`) demultiplexes per
provider. At pearl startup AiLagoon asks Sandstorm for a single
HTTP-out permission to that host — the shell renders the
address-selector popup (not the pearl picker), and the operator grants
or denies the host once. Connections persist across pearl restarts via
`SandstormApi.save()` / `restore()`.

## Playground

A built-in chat playground lets you test any connected model without
leaving the pearl — useful for validating credentials, checking
capabilities, or prototyping prompts before calling them from another
pearl via Grapple. Every assistant reply renders a **provenance card**
underneath the bubble: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp, request-ID (cross-
referenceable in `/audit`), provider+connection name, and a
sealed/cleartext pill so compliance officers can attribute and time-
stamp every output without leaving the chat.

## Transcript anchoring — roadmap, not shipped

AiLagoon does **not** currently anchor inference transcripts on-chain.
Earlier catalog copy described "Solana-pinned inference transcripts"
as a shipped feature; that was overclaim. As of v0.7.11 the only
on-chain artifact AiLagoon participates in is the **publish-side**
ReleaseEntry that signs this SPK manifest itself (program
`7anRCW8UAFwdSAAxkrK7TmptukNKY74nZrNPfRKzzWLb`, PDA in the catalog
`attest` block). Per-conversation transcript pinning to the user's
Squads-controlled wallet is on the v0.8 roadmap; until then,
transcripts live append-only in the pearl's encrypted SQLite store
and surface in the audit log as metadata only (no prompt/response
content retained, by design — see `pkg/audit/logger.go`).

apps.description:
BotMother is a Telegram bot manager with message routing and chatroom support, running on Melusina. Each bot configuration lives in its own Pearl — a sealed, per-document container with its own database, message history, and permissions.

## Why BotMother

- **Pinned chatroom snapshots** — cryptographically anchor any chatroom snapshot to your Solana wallet; snapshots are tamper-evident, citable across Pearls via Grapple, and verifiable independent of the operator
- **Per-bot Pearl isolation** — each bot runs in its own sealed container with separate storage, config, and message logs; no bot Pearl can see another unless you explicitly connect via Grapple
- **Wallet-rooted bot identity** — bot tokens and credentials stored locally; bot ownership linked to Solana wallet; non-repudiable access logs

## Features

- **Message Routing** — define rules to route incoming messages by command, keyword, or sender
- **Chatroom Support** — manage group conversations and route messages between channels
- **Grapple Connections** — link BotMother Pearls to other app Pearls — trigger actions in Bureau spreadsheets, pipe notifications into Mermail, or log events to MiniGit
- **Webhook Integration** — receive and process Telegram webhook events in real-time
- **Privacy-First** — all messages stay on your server; no third-party bot hosting; no message logging by others
- **Offline Queuing** — messages received while offline are queued and processed when the bot reconnects

## Setup

1. Create a bot via BotFather on Telegram
2. Copy the bot token
3. Create a new BotMother Pearl and paste the token
4. Define your routing rules
5. Your bot is live — routing messages through your own server

## Security Model

- Viewer — see bot status and message logs
- Editor — configure routing rules, manage chatrooms
- Admin — manage bot tokens, permissions, and Grapple connections

Every message, every routing rule, every bot token stays inside the Pearl. Server-side permission enforcement — no client-side trust.

## Status

*Production.* Free to install and use on your own server. No subscription, no per-message fees, no limits.

apps.description:
Bureau Cal is the calendar pearl of the Melusina Bureau office suite. Personal and shared calendars, event scheduling, recurring reminders, and iCal/CalDAV interop — entirely on your server, in your jurisdiction.

## Why Cal

- **Pinned event-state snapshots** — cryptographically anchor any calendar snapshot to your Solana wallet; the snapshot is tamper-evident, citable across Pearls via Grapple, and verifiable independent of the operator
- **Per-calendar pearl** — share pearl-by-pearl, not org-wide; each calendar is a sealed container
- **iCal/CalDAV import + export** — interop with Apple, Outlook, Google Calendar, or any CalDAV client

## Features

- **Shared calendars** with role-based permission (viewer / editor / admin)
- **Reminders** via Melusina notifications, Telegram (via BotMother), or email (via Mermail)
- **Time zones, recurring events, all-day, multi-day** — the fundamentals done right

## Suite integration

Bureau Cal speaks Grapple to the rest of the Bureau suite — link a Doc to an event, surface a board's deadlines on the calendar, attach a sheet to a meeting agenda.

## Status

*Pre-release.* The pearl currently installs as a Coming Soon stub; the live calendar lands in v0.2.

apps.name: cyberteller
apps.shortDescription: Multi-chain crypto payment processor — invoicing + address generation + settlement.
apps.description:
cyberteller is a multi-chain crypto payment processor for Melusina. Create invoices, generate unique payment addresses per chain, track payments in real-time, and settle crypto across Ethereum, Tron, Solana, and TON.

## Why cyberteller

- **Pinned invoice + settlement chains** — cryptographically anchor any invoice and its settlement chain to your Solana wallet; records are tamper-evident, citable across Pearls via Grapple, and compliance-ready
- **Address non-reuse by HD-wallet derivation** — every invoice gets a fresh address derived via BIP-39/BIP-32 (secp256k1) and SLIP-0010 (ed25519); no address reuse; no payment correlation; privacy by design
- **YAML-driven, restart-free configuration** — edit chains, tokens, expiry, and tolerance thresholds via the admin UI; changes take effect immediately; no deployment cycles

## Features

- **Multi-chain support** — Ethereum, Tron, Solana, TON
- **Crypto & stablecoins** — ETH, TRX, SOL, TON native coins + USDT/USDC on every supported chain
- **Invoice API** — create invoices via REST with amount, currency, description, and customer details
- **Payment page** — customer-facing page with QR codes and copy-address buttons; auto-refreshes
- **Payment status tracking** — paid / underpaid / overpaid / expired
- **Webhook endpoint** — integrate blockchain monitoring services for real-time settlement notification
- **Admin panel** — dashboard, invoice detail view, live YAML config editor
- **SQLite storage** — zero external dependencies; fully offline-capable

## Status

*Pre-release.* The pearl currently installs as a Coming Soon stub; the live payment processor lands in v0.2.

Diagram Bureau is the diagramming pearl of the Melusina Bureau office suite. Flowcharts, org charts, mindmaps, UML diagrams, and architecture diagrams with the full draw.io engine — entirely on your server, real-time collaboration.

- **Pinned diagram revisions** — cryptographically anchor any diagram snapshot to your Solana wallet; the snapshot is tamper-evident, citable across Pearls via Grapple, and verifiable independent of the operator
- **Edit-lock with live viewers** — one editor at a time; all connected viewers see changes appear live, no conflicts
- **Multi-format export** — XML, PNG, SVG, PDF; no lock-in

## Features

- **Full draw.io (mxGraph)** — the same engine used by millions; complete stencil library; every shape and connector
- **Diagram types** — flowcharts, org charts, UML, ER, BPMN, network topology, freeform drawing
- **Per-diagram pearl** — each diagram is a sealed container; share by pearl, not org-wide
- **Offline-capable** — all draw.io assets bundled; no internet needed

## Suite integration

Diagram Bureau speaks Grapple to the rest of the Bureau suite — reference a spreadsheet in a flow, link a document to an architecture decision, embed a diagram in a CanBoard card.

## Status

*Shipped v2.0.16.* Full draw.io engine, real-time collaborative editing, Solana-pinned revisions.

Fineract Setup is the Melusina companion wizard for Apache Fineract integration. It provisions the attached Fineract backend, walks the operator through the bootstrap workflow, and exports a signed trust bundle shared by both security gates.

- **Cryptographically pinned configuration bundles** — anchor any configuration bundle to your Solana wallet; bundles are tamper-evident, citable across Pearls via Grapple, verifiable independent of the operator, and audit-ready for compliance

## Bootstrap Workflow

The wizard packages the cold-start work that has to happen before cca.sh can talk to a hardened Fineract install:

- Tenant setup

apps.name: InstaDAO
apps.shortDescription: Deploy + manage a Solana DAO
apps.description:
# InstaDAO

Deploy and manage a Solana DAO from a single Sandstorm grain. Wizard-driven entity + governance + treasury + cap-table setup, with optional utility-token and holder-voting modules. **Nothing is hardcoded** — each grain stands up its own DAO with its own programs, mint, signers, and parameters.

## What it does

- **10-step Onboarding Wizard** — entity setup, module selection, directors + officers, founders cap-table, OA drafting, deploy quote, on-chain deploy, init-state finalize.
- **DAO Dashboard** — cap-table, governance, treasury, activity for the deployed DAO. Driven by the DAO's own on-chain state — not by any baked-in mint or program.
- **Optional Utility Token** — mint, freeze, burn, standing-offer (USDC + SOL routes) for the DAO's own token, parameterized at deploy time.
- **Optional Holder Voting** — token-weighted proposals with a binding sha256 commitment to question text.
- **Squads-Gated Admin** — every privileged action is a multisig proposal; the grain author can't move the DAO without quorum.
- **Telegram Bot** — optional out-of-band notifications via a Grapple-bound HTTP-out capability.

## Why this design

Sandstorm gives every grain its own root-owned ext4 sandbox + revocable capabilities. We use those to keep the DAO operator's keypairs encrypted at rest, route every Solana RPC through the Melusina shell's `HackSessionContext.solanaRpc` (no outbound HTTP from the grain), and let the operator share read-only or proposal-author roles per Sandstorm's permission grid.

## Upgrading from MLSNA Admin v3.0.x

Existing MLSNA grains auto-upgrade in place — same appId, new versionNumber (51 > 50). Per-tenant config at `/var/melusina/mlsna-admin.env` is still honored; rename to `instadao.env` on the next deploy.

apps.shortDescription: Sovereign email client for Melusina with pearl-based mail server control
apps.description:
MerMail is a sovereign email client for [Melusina](https://melusina-os.org), built with Go and HTMX. It connects directly to Melusina's Cap'n Proto APIs — no HTTP bridge required.

## Features

- **Inbox & Folders** — View, organise, and search your email across custom folders
- **Compose & Reply** — Rich compose form with reply, reply-all, and forward support
- **Attachments** — Upload, download, and inline-view attachments
- **Drafts** — Auto-save and manually save drafts; resume editing anytime
- **Search** — Full-text search across all messages
- **Star & Organise** — Star important messages, move between folders, bulk delete
- **Real-time Updates** — WebSocket push for new mail notifications
- **Role-based Access** — Melusina sharing with viewer, editor, and admin roles
- **Lightweight** — Single static binary, SQLite storage, zero external dependencies

## pearl Types

MerMail ships two pearl types:

- **Mailbox pearl** — Your personal email client. Each pearl is an independent mailbox with its own inbox, folders, drafts, and contacts.
- **Station pearl** — Mail server control panel for managing forwarding rules, DNS configuration, and aliases.

## How It Works

Each Melusina pearl is an independent mailbox. Email arrives via Melusina's built-in SMTP gateway and is stored locally in SQLite. The UI is server-rendered HTML with HTMX for seamless partial updates — no JavaScript framework required.

## Getting Started

1. Open the App Bazaar and install MerMail
2. Create a new **Mailbox** pearl to start using email
3. Your pearl gets a unique email address — forward mail to it or share it directly
4. Create a **Station** pearl to manage mail server settings

## Technical Details

- **Backend:** Go with native Cap'n Proto RPC (no sandstorm-http-bridge)
- **Frontend:** Server-side HTML + HTMX + WebSocket
- **Storage:** SQLite with automatic migrations
- **Binary:** Statically linked, runs inside the Melusina pearl sandbox

apps.name: MiniGit
apps.shortDescription: Lightweight private Git hosting on Melusina — one repo per pearl, browse and push from your browser, AI-callable.
apps.description:
MiniGit provides lightweight, private Git hosting inside a Melusina pearl. Clone, push, browse commits, diffs, and manage branches — all from your browser, entirely on your server.

## Why MiniGit

- **Per-pearl isolation** — each pearl is one sealed repository; separate storage, separate permissions; no cross-pearl leakage; a vulnerability in one pearl cannot reach another
- **Melusina-native access control** — clone, fetch and push are gated by the same share-link permissions (viewer / editor / admin) as the web UI; no separate accounts
- **No third-party CDN/Git gateway** — all repositories hosted locally; no GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket; no vendor lock-in; export anytime

## Features

- **One repo per pearl** — the pearl IS the repository; share the pearl to share the repo.
- **Push and pull over HTTPS** — clone URL provided automatically
- **Browse files, commits, and diffs** — in the web UI
- **Share read-only or read/write access** — via standard Melusina sharing
- **No external database** — go-git in-process; the bare repo on disk plus tiny JSON sidecars under the pearl's data dir; zero external services.
- **Fully offline-capable** — no CDN or external calls
- **Role-based access** — viewer, editor, admin

## AI-callable Skills

The pearl exposes a Melusina `GrainContext` capability — its "Skills" — so a compatible AI agent can browse files, read commits, write commits, manage branches, and apply patches through a declarative operations table, called via `describe` / `invoke` over capnp. The operations a caller sees are filtered by the same share-link permission bitset as the human UI: view-only callers never see write operations.

## Status

**Stable (0.2.4)** — full Git hosting (clone / fetch / push over HTTPS), web browsing of trees, blobs, commits and diffs, a lightweight issue + pull-request tracker, and an AI-callable operations surface — all available now.

apps.description:
**NamedCoin** is the KYC onboarding pearl for Melusina.

Pass an identity + sanctions check once, and a time-boxed KYC attestation is recorded against your Solana wallet with a configurable expiry (90/180/365 days, up to five years). Every Melusina app that needs "is this person KYC'd?" probes the on-chain attestation — no re-upload, no storage of raw ID documents inside other grains.

Raw ID images + questionnaire answers never leave the pearl's encrypted store. What lands on-chain is a Merkle root over salted (key, value) claim leaves; apps verify individual claims (e.g. "residence is FR") with a selective-disclosure Merkle probe through the sidecar.

Admin-side review (KYC packet approval, sanctions list configuration, issue / revoke, consumer-trust editing) lives in the companion admin pearl: melusina-NamedCoin-admin-app.

Built in Go with HTMX + vanilla templates. Sandstorm pearl with HTTP-out to the TeleScreen sidecar for sanctions screening and AI Lagoon for document-authenticity / face-match checks.

Vintage Remote Desktop gives every Melusina operator a disposable, full Linux desktop rendered in the browser. Pearls start in sandbox mode — every change is ephemeral and wiped when the pearl closes. Click Save to upgrade the pearl to a persistent, Solana-backed workspace.

## Why Vintage

- **Pinned session snapshots** — cryptographically anchor any desktop session to your Solana wallet; snapshots are tamper-evident, citable across Pearls via Grapple, and recoverable if the session crashes
- **Ephemeral-first sandbox** — by default, everything is temporary; persistence is an explicit choice, not a default; ideal for one-off work that shouldn't pollute your environment
- **Wallet-rooted persistent state** — when you click Save, session state is anchored to your Solana wallet; ownership and restoration tied to your key; no operator backdoor

## Ideal For

- One-off tooling that you don't want polluting your main environment
- Demo environments that reset cleanly
- Remote-ops consoles where persistence should be an explicit choice, not a default
- Isolated testing and experimentation

## Features

- **Full Linux desktop** — apt, gcc, git, Python, Node, Docker, and standard utilities
- **Browser-based** — no VNC client, no RDP software; open in any browser
- **File transfer** — drag-drop files into the desktop; export files back out
- **Clipboard sync** — paste between your computer and the remote desktop
- **Audio** — WebRTC audio support for VoIP and media playback
- **Offline-capable** — all assets bundled; no external calls

## Status

*Shipped v1.0.0.* Browser-based Linux desktop with ephemeral sandbox default, Solana-pinned session snapshots, full-featured toolchain.
